home.title: Green coffee, closer.
home.intro: Curated specialty and commercial coffees, backed by local teams and ready from Egypt and Dubai.
home.featuredBody: Distinct coffees selected for clarity, consistency, and reliable local supply.
home.network: Two warehouses. One connected supply network.
home.networkBody: Choose the stock point that works for your operation, with transparent offer details and a local team nearby.
home.egyptBody: Local stock for Egyptian roasters, supported by responsive planning and sample coordination.
home.dubaiBody: A regional hub for roasters across the Gulf, with flexible availability and logistics support.
home.storyBody: We connect thoughtful sourcing with grounded local service—helping roasters choose confidently from sample to shipment.
home.sourceBody: Clear specifications, considered selections, and people who understand how every detail affects the cup.
home.sustain: Progress should travel through the whole chain.
home.sustainBody: Our approach values long-term partnerships, responsible decisions, and coffees that create durable value.
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you roast, the profile you need, and where you need it.
home.featuredEmpty: No featured coffees are published right now.
home.originsBody: Explore the places and contexts behind every published coffee.
home.originsEmpty: No origins are published right now.
home.warehouseEmpty: No warehouse locations are published right now.
home.accountBody: A verified account unlocks protected pricing, favourites, and tracked requests.
home.knowledgeEmpty: No articles are published right now.
home.tradeBody: Our Dubai hub serves roasters across the Gulf, with Egyptian stock close behind for the North African market. Every lot is requested, reviewed, and confirmed by people — there is no checkout here.
home.step1Body: Every published lot shows its origin, region, processing method, variety, warehouse, and lot reference — open to anyone, no account required.
home.step2Title: Request an offer or a sample
home.step2Body: Send a sourcing request, or ask for a sample of a specific coffee. Both take a few details and give you a reference code straight away.
home.step3Body: Our coffee team reviews every request and follows up directly with availability, pricing, and next steps.
home.traceBody: Origin, growing region, processing method, variety, and the warehouse a lot sits in are recorded against every published coffee, so a sourcing decision rests on the record rather than a description.
home.accessBody: Anyone can browse the catalogue and send a request. Contract pricing, saved coffees, and your request history live behind a verified account.
home.heroTitle: Buy coffee with a clearer line back to origin.
home.heroIntro: Specialty-grade green coffee for roasters, HORECA operators, private labels and traders across the Arab region.
home.pathsTitle: One business. Three clear ways to buy.
home.path1Who: When you know the profile, not the lot
home.path1What: Tell us the cup profile, process, volume, delivery market and timing. We come back with the right offer or a sourcing route.
home.path2Who: When you want what is in store now
home.path2What: Origin, process, grade, crop, minimum quantity and availability are published for every lot. Request a sample or a commercial quote.
home.path3What: Allocated inventory, storage, resale and settlement under agreed commercial controls. It is a private workspace, not a public exchange.
home.path3Access: Need access? Tell us about your business

about.title: Global perspective. Local accountability.
about.intro: Hills Coffee exists to make green coffee sourcing more legible, more responsive, and more human for roasters across our region.
about.oneBody: Useful specifications, honest availability, and direct answers help teams make better buying decisions.
about.twoBody: We consider cup quality alongside consistency, purpose, logistics, and the realities of each roasting business.
about.threeBody: Long-term value comes from listening well and staying accountable across seasons.
